svg.title: How to read a density plot
svg.desc: A smooth density curve over test scores from 20 to 100. The curve has a tall peak near 52 (the most common scores), a smaller second peak near 78, and thin tails at both ends. A shaded band between scores 60 and 70 shows that the area under the curve between two values is the share of the data in that range. The total area under the whole curve is 1, or 100%. Short ticks along the bottom, a rug, show the individual scores.
svg.text: Main peak: the most common values
Shaded area = estimated share of scores between 60 and 70 (about 13%)
Total area under the curve = 1 (100% of the data). Ticks along the axis (a rug) mark each value.
